executive_summary: [lab-host-12] Triage and prioritization analysis for identified vulnerabilities on lab-host-12:80/tcp running Apache httpd 2.4.49. [lab-host-13] Vulnerability triage and prioritization report for VulnTriage-AI isolated lab identifying three findings related to Apache Tomcat, including critical CORS and AJP vulnerabilities as well as a medium severity HTTP parsing vulnerability. [lab-host-17] Triage and prioritization analysis for authorized lab assets including Elasticsearch REST API vulnerabilities. [lab-host-20] Triage and prioritization analysis for identified vulnerabilities on asset lab-host-20:5000/tcp running Werkzeug httpd v2.2.2. [lab-host-16] Triage and prioritization analysis for authorized lab assets identifying vulnerabilities in Jenkins. [lab-host-18] A medium-severity vulnerability (CVE-2023-45648) was identified in Apache Tomcat running on lab-host-18:8080. The flaw is an improper input validation issue (CWE-20) that could allow an attacker to exploit the public-facing application. The EPSS score indicates a moderate likelihood of exploitation, and the risk prioritization rules have assigned a medium priority. Immediate patching or upgrade of Tomcat is recommended.

findings.label: urgent

findings.remediation: Update Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later, where path normalization flaws are properly resolved. Ensure configuration options such as Require all denied are strictly enforced for directories outside the web root. Sources: MITRE CWE - CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

findings.evidence: Host: lab-host-13, port: 8080, service: Apache Tomcat, version: 8.5.19
findings.label: urgent

findings.remediation: Disable the AJP connector if it is not required by your architecture. If AJP is required, upgrade Apache Tomcat to a patched version, restrict access to trusted internal proxies, and explicitly configure the requiredSecret attribute on the AJP connector. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-20 Improper Input Validation).

findings.attack_technique: T1677 (Poisoned Pipeline Execution) / T1203 (Exploitation for Client Execution)
findings.remediation: Upgrade Elasticsearch to version 1.6.1 or later to mitigate remote code execution vectors.
